**Tier 2 — niche reference**

**Design target:** Tier B (Olifant) + Tier C (AMZ Dudes).

**Helium 10 agencies:** Not in the competitor set. “Helium 10” only appears in migrated blog excerpts as a seller tool, not as an agency competitor.

---

## 2. Homepage section patterns documented per competitor

### Full homepage section inventories (`COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`)

| Competitor | Documented homepage sections |
|------------|------------------------------|
| **Olifant** | Hero + CTA; revenue ticker; 60-day guarantee; 15+ case cards; video testimonials; multi-city offices |
| **AMZ Dudes** | Stat cards under hero; numbered services 01–09; seller-type tabs; lead modal; WhatsApp float |
| **Canopy** | Dark high-contrast hero; awards wall (17+); video case studies; category/vertical selector; footer stats |
| **MAG** | Trust density; 4-pillar services; 10+ FAQ + schema; YouTube; long-form service content |
| **Sequence** | Agency vs in-house vs generalist table; vertical playbooks; AIO/GEO; review scores; multi-office |
| **SalesDuo** | Agency-type tabs; channel segmentation; scale stats |
| **Incrementum** | DataOwl showcase; founder story; Trustpilot; ads focus |
| **AMZ One Step** | Before/after galleries; days-to-result cards; CEO letter; portfolio layout |
| **Evolve** | Content library as homepage; category nav; split-test focus |

### Cross-competitor “adopt” matrix (`Competitor-Analysis.md`)

Hero (Olifant/Canopy) → Trust bar (MAG/Sequence) → Stats (AMZ Dudes) → Services (MAG/SalesDuo) → Segmentation (AMZ Dudes) → Cases (Olifant/Canopy) → Process (Olifant) → Comparison (Sequence) → Testimonials (Olifant) → FAQ (MAG) → Blog (Evolve/Sequence) → CTA (AMZ Dudes/Olifant)

### Tier-grouped section patterns (`Design-Inspiration.md`)

Same agencies, organized by Tier A–D with adopt/skip notes (e.g. skip dark hero, skip proprietary tools, skip 12-office footer).

### Hero-only deep dive (`HERO-COMPETITOR-UI-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md`)

MAG, AMZ Dudes (account-mgmt page), Canopy, AMZ One Step — layout, H1 size, CTA, visual, trust, adopt/skip. Target: light split + one product frame + metric overlays; dual CTA; no form-in-hero; no dark cinematic.

### Narrower UI notes (not full section maps)

- Atmosphere: Canopy / Olifant — `COMPETITOR-PAGE-ATMOSPHERE-2026-09-03.md`
- Max-width: Canopy 1400 / AMZ Dudes 1320 / Olifant 1320 — `COMPETITOR-MAX-WIDTH-2026-09-03.md`
- Nav / ribbon / CTA — `HEADER-NAV-RIBBON-CTA-2026-09-02.md`

---

## 3. Differentiation notes already recorded

**Proposed statement** (COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH + Competitor-Analysis + homepage redesign brief):

> Full-service Amazon account management with an in-house team of specialists. Not a call center. Not a software dashboard. Real people who treat your brand like their own.

**Compete on:** 95% retention, in-house specialists, Amazon Ads Verified Partner, 328-post blog moat, GoSports 310% case study, personal mid-market attention.

**Do not compete on:** Enterprise scale ($3B+ / 400+ staff), multi-office global presence, proprietary platforms, unverified “AI-powered” claims, metric inflation.

**Honest metric frame:** eCG $112M+ / 95% / 20+ / since 2018 vs Olifant / Canopy / AMZ Dudes scale numbers (documented comparison table).

**Sweet spot:** Between AMZ Dudes (hands-on mid-market) and Olifant (boutique premium); not Canopy/MAG enterprise.
